label_policy.review_rule: Actions, source-style cues, and glyph-support expectations are source-pixel review annotations. They are not masks, cleanup assets, replacements, translations, or implementation authorization.
label_policy.replacement_rule: replace is an intended candidate action only. A later policy decision, approved glyph support, and validated cleanup remain required before pixels may change.
label_policy.preservation_rule: preserve retains source pixels and forbids automatic cleanup and automatic replacement text. The retained OCR record remains usable as non-raster metadata.
